system_config.title: 1064nm Raman DMD Spectrometer with Thorlabs AC254-040-C Relay & ACL25416U Condenser
system_config.description: Manual optimized 1064 nm excitation Raman spectrometer featuring a 2-lens detection arm: a Thorlabs AC254-040-C achromatic doublet (EFL=40mm, 1-inch diameter, NIR C-coated 1050-1700nm) as a collimating relay after the DMD, followed by a Thorlabs ACL25416U aspheric condenser lens (EFL=16mm) focusing onto the single-element detector.
